feature: Portal team roster - Billing/Customer Admin role assignment. PATCH /api/portal/team/:userId/role (artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-team.ts, #3647) lets a caller holding customer:team.manage (Customer Admin holds it) grant/revoke the two #3629 platform-default customer roles - customer-admin and billing - on a teammate. #4013 wires this into the real UI: `artifacts/portal/src/pages/customer-team.tsx`'s ROLES block (role chips on roster rows, a Held/Not-held card per role with grant/revoke buttons and confirm modals naming the exact audit action + role key, a self-revoke refusal for a caller's own Customer Admin role) now reads/writes it via `useTeamLive.setRole`. `GET /api/portal/team` reports each member's isCustomerAdmin/hasBillingRole (#3647) and the new isBilledParty (#4013 - whether they are the real #3629-trigger billed party, i.e. hold an invoices/client_services row addressed to them, distinct from holding Billing by manual grant) flags the UI now consumes.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the route's real auth-gate (401 unauthenticated) and input-validation gates (400 on an unrecognised role key, 400 on a non-boolean granted) against the live running api-server, proving the route is genuinely wired and reachable - not just unit-tested in isolation.

WHAT THIS DELIBERATELY DOES NOT COVER, AND WHY: the grant/revoke business logic itself (tenant isolation, the customer:team.manage capability gate, the self-demotion guard preventing a caller from removing their own Customer Admin role, and the actual customer_user_roles write) is exhaustively covered by artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-team.test.ts's own vitest suite (14 tests) - that suite can grant a real cap.team.manage role to a synthetic caller id via setGrantRole() directly against the mocked db, which this manifest's designated testbed account cannot be assumed to hold. Asserting a successful 200 grant here would require a testbed account already known to hold customer:team.manage, which is not established for any test-manifests/portal/*.json account today.

UI now exists (#4013, following the design landed at Design/portal/design_handoff_billing_roles_and_new_modules/screens/Team Management.dc.html) but is not driven here: exercising the ROLES block's grant/revoke buttons needs a logged-in session as an account known to hold customer:team.manage, which no test-manifests/portal/*.json account currently establishes - same reasoning as the apiTests-only scope above. See test-manifests/portal/team-management.json for the page's own unauthenticated-visit uiStep.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL only (no login needed - every assertion below is on the auth/validation gate, which fires before any body/role logic runs).
